title: The Boat
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Oscar reveals he is having a secret affair with Senator Lipton and asks Kevin to keep it confidential. Meanwhile, Andy struggles with the financial necessity of selling his family's beloved boat, despite its sentimental value, and attempts to sail it one last time with Erin's encouragement. Dwight faces a public relations crisis when accusations arise about Dunder Mifflin's paper being toxic, leading to a stock price crash and his refusal to resign. The episode also features humorous moments such as Dwight's unconventional radio interview and Kevin's frequent bathroom excuses. The episode ends with unresolved tensions around the boat sale, Dwight's crisis, and Oscar's affair.
